scope.note: Phase 3 scope. Items under excluded are never required; their panel controls exist visually but stay decorative and are listed as unsupported.
required: Two layers (A, B) sharing one effect chain
Four audibly distinct engines: B3, Vox, Farf, Pipe 1
Nine drawbars with LED graphs driving the audible spectrum per model
B3 percussion (on, volume soft, decay fast, harmonic third) and key click
Vibrato/chorus selector (C1-C3, V1-V3) with per-layer on/off for B3
Rotary routing with slow/fast/stop and morphable speed
optional: B3 Bass as a distinct engine (may reuse the B3 engine limited to 16' and 8' drawbars)
Pipe 2 as a distinct engine (may reuse Pipe 1 with a brighter principal registration)
excluded: Preset/Drawbar Live modes and drawbar sync (physical-drawbar concepts; virtual drawbars always show live values)
Tonewheel wear modes, keyboard trigger point, and Sound-menu rotary tuning (manual p. 58)
Organ preset library (cut benchmark-wide; see programs spec)

architecture.differentModelsPerLayer: Layers A and B may use different organ models simultaneously (manual p. 18).

models.drawbars: seven partials plus a filtered/unfiltered mix drawbar
on/off register switches (pulled past half = on)

percussion.on: Adds a decaying attack partial from a single shared envelope (manual p. 20).
percussion.singleTriggered: Percussion retriggers only after all keys are released (default; manual p. 20).

b3.keyClick: Short random click transient on note attack at a fixed level (manual p. 20).

drawbars.interaction: Each drawbar is a vertical control with an LED graph; dragging or keyboard input changes its 0-8 position and the audible spectrum immediately.
drawbars.legends: B3 footages printed below the drawbars; Vox/Farf/Pipe legends printed above (manual p. 18).

vibratoChorus.behavior: Vibrato modulates pitch; chorus mixes the modulated signal with the original. At minimum V1 and C1 must be audibly distinct effects and depth must increase across 1-3 (manual p. 19).

rotary.routing: The ORGAN button in the Rotary group routes the organ to the shared rotary speaker (manual p. 53).
rotary.accelerationRequired: Speed changes ramp over time rather than switching instantly.

acceptance: B3, Vox, Farf, and Pipe 1 produce observably distinct harmonic behavior; a single renamed oscillator does not satisfy this.
Every drawbar movement changes the audible spectrum and its LED graph for the selected model.
B3 percussion, key click, and vibrato/chorus each measurably change rendered audio.
Rotary slow/fast/stop transitions accelerate smoothly and audibly for routed organ sound.
Both layers support enable, focus, level, octave shift, zone assignment, and the shared effect chain.
